question: From given options the number that will completely divide (3⁶¹ + 3⁶² + 3⁶³ + 3⁶⁴) is:
solution:
**Given:**

(361 + 362 + 363 + 364)

**Calculation:**

(361 + 362 + 363 + 364)

⇒ 3⁶¹(1 + 3 + 3² + 3³)

⇒ 361 × (1 + 3 + 9 + 27) 

⇒ 361 × 40 

⇒ 3⁶⁰ × 3 × 4 × 10 

⇒360 × 4 × 30 

∵ The above expression has 30 in it. In other words 30 is one of the factors of the given expression.

**∴ 30 will divide (361 + 362 + 363 + 364) completely.**
